_comment: Standardized voice and pacing configuration across all seven script formats.
Every category uses the same voice profile: Alex — Upbeat, Energetic and Clear (natural pace, about 177 WPM).
Run `python tools/clip.py voices` to resolve Alex's voice_id on your ElevenLabs account (saved to config/voices.local.json).

pacing.note: Alex speaks at his natural pace, measured at about 177 WPM on eleven_v4 (accepted 165-190). The voice is never sped up. Scripts of 170-198 words run about 58-68 s (limit 70 s, style/style.json). On v2 fallback models `speed` stays 1.0 so a fallback take matches.

Alex.character: upbeat, energetic, clear, conversational, expressive, confident, fast-paced storyteller

unspoken-rules.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and conversational, leaning into eerie curiosity and suspense. Natural ~177 WPM pace; shift naturally with [knowing], [suspicious], [serious], [dramatic], and [deadpan] or [amazed] on the chilling final twist.

slow-burn.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and gripping. Keep forward momentum at Alex's natural ~177 WPM; build taut tension with [serious], [suspicious], and [fast-paced], then land the perspective flip with emotional contrast ([dramatic], [amazed], [knowing]).

twist.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and mischievously confident. Natural ~177 WPM friend-telling-a-story rhythm; mix [energetic], [amused], [knowing], [suspicious], [dramatic], and punchy [deadpan] or [ironic] payoffs.

rule-of-three.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and playful. Natural ~177 WPM storytelling with comedic timing; use [upbeat], [amused], [confused], [dismissive], [knowing], and [ironic] or [laughs] as the clever third try lands.

micro-butterfly.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and incredulous storyteller (never a dry lecture). Natural ~177 WPM domino momentum; use [energetic], [knowing], [fast-paced], [suspicious], [dramatic], and [ironic] or [deadpan] on the jaw-dropping final detail.

ticking-clock.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and high-stakes. Natural ~177 WPM adrenaline without sacrificing intelligibility on key survival details; drive urgency with [energetic], [fast-paced], [serious], [dramatic], and [excited] or [amazed] on the escape.

reverse-chronology.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and fast-on-his-feet comedic thriller energy. Natural ~177 WPM pace; play up the absurd opener and frantic rewind with [energetic], [confused], [amused], [fast-paced], [excited], and [knowing] or [laughs] on the payoff.
